name: 詹妮弗·杜德纳
bio_short: 美国生物化学家，加州大学伯克利分校教授，2020年诺贝尔化学奖得主。她与埃雷曼纽尔·卡彭蒂耶共同发明了革命性的CRISPR-Cas9基因编辑技术（`crispr_gene_editing_2012`），赋予了人类精确修改DNA的能力，开启了基因工程的新纪元。
bio_short_en: An American biochemist, professor at UC Berkeley, and 2020 Nobel laureate in Chemistry. She co-invented the revolutionary CRISPR-Cas9 gene-editing technology (`crispr_gene_editing_2012`) with Emmanuelle Charpentier, giving humanity the power to precisely modify DNA and ushering in a new era of genetic engineering.
